`diff-gpui-web` is an experimental `wasm32-unknown-unknown` shell around the reusable `diff-gpui::DiffViewer`. It renders one GPUI window into the document-owned canvas. Git discovery and agent communication remain host/server responsibilities.

The shell constructs `gpui_web::WebPlatform` with multithreading disabled, matching `gpui_platform::single_threaded_web()`. The pinned `gpui_platform` revision enables `gpui_web`'s multithreaded default transitively, so the shell uses the equivalent constructor directly to keep stable-Rust browser builds free of `SharedArrayBuffer` and COOP/COEP requirements.

GPUI prefers WebGPU and automatically falls back to WebGL2. The current upstream browser platform supports one top-level canvas window; native menus, dialogs, filesystem access, process execution, and Git are intentionally unavailable.
